# Date & time

Calendar, pickers and the event calendar.

[Calendar](#calendar) · [DatePicker](#datepicker) · [DateRangePicker](#daterangepicker) · [MonthPicker, MonthField](#monthpicker-monthfield) · [TimeField](#timefield) · [EventCalendar](#eventcalendar)

### Calendar

A month grid for a single date or a date range, with month and year views. The picker components below are built on it.

```ts
import { Calendar, MonthGrid, YearGrid, CalNav } from '@/kit/components/calendar/Calendar'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `'single' \| 'range'` | `'single'` | Selection type. |
| `value` *(required)* | `Date \| null \| { from: Date \| null; to: Date \| null }` |  | Selected date, or range in range mode. |
| `onChange` *(required)* | `(value) => void` |  | Called with the new date, or range. |
| `min` | `Date` |  | Earliest selectable date. |
| `max` | `Date` |  | Latest selectable date. |
| `isDisabled` | `(d: Date) => boolean` |  | Disables individual days. |
| `marks` | `Record<string, "accent" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "error">` |  | Colored dots under days, keyed by YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `months` | `1 \| 2` | `1` | Months shown side by side. |
| `defaultMonth` | `Date` |  | Month shown first when nothing is selected. |
| `month` | `Date` |  | Controlled visible month. |
| `onMonthChange` | `(month: Date) => void` |  | Called when the visible month changes. |
| `autoFocus` | `boolean` |  | Moves keyboard focus into the grid on mount (use inside popovers). |

```tsx
<Calendar mode="range" months={2} value={range} onChange={setRange} max={new Date()} />
```

- Arrow keys move by day, PageUp/PageDown by month (Shift for a year), Home/End to the week’s start/end.
- The first day of the week and all month and weekday names follow the locale in the theme config.

### DatePicker

An input-style button that opens a calendar in a popover.

```ts
import { DatePicker } from '@/kit/components/calendar/DatePicker'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` *(required)* | `Date \| null` |  | Selected date. |
| `onChange` *(required)* | `(value: Date \| null) => void` |  | Called with the chosen date, or null when cleared. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `'Select date'` | Shown when empty. |
| `min` | `Date` |  | Earliest selectable date. |
| `max` | `Date` |  | Latest selectable date. |
| `defaultMonth` | `Date` |  | Month shown first when empty (e.g. 18 years ago for a birth date). |
| `isDisabled` | `(d: Date) => boolean` |  | Disables individual days. |
| `clearable` | `boolean` |  | Adds a Clear action. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Disables the control. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` |  | Accessible name when not inside a Field. |

```tsx
<Field label="Date of birth"><DatePicker value={dob} onChange={setDob} max={eighteenYearsAgo} defaultMonth={eighteenYearsAgo} /></Field>
```

### DateRangePicker

A range picker with quick ranges (Last 7 days, Year to date …), two months on wide screens, and Apply / Cancel.

```ts
import { DateRangePicker } from '@/kit/components/calendar/DateRangePicker'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` *(required)* | `{ from: Date \| null; to: Date \| null }` |  | Selected range. |
| `onChange` *(required)* | `(value) => void` |  | Called when the range is applied. |
| `min` | `Date` |  | Earliest selectable date. |
| `max` | `Date` | `today` | Latest selectable date. |
| `presets` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the quick ranges column. |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  | Shown when empty. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` |  | Accessible name when not inside a Field. |

```tsx
<DateRangePicker value={range} onChange={setRange} ariaLabel="Date range" />
```

### MonthPicker, MonthField

A 3×4 month grid with a year header (MonthPicker), and an input-style trigger that opens it in a popover (MonthField).

```ts
import { MonthPicker, MonthField } from '@/kit/components/calendar/MonthPicker'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` *(required)* | `{ year: number; month: number } \| null` |  | Selected month (month is 0–11). |
| `onChange` *(required)* | `(value: YearMonth) => void` |  | Called with the chosen month. |
| `min` | `Date` |  | Earliest selectable date. |
| `max` | `Date` |  | Latest selectable date. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `'Select month'` | MonthField: shown when empty. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` |  | MonthField: accessible name when not inside a Field. |

```tsx
<MonthField value={{ year: 2026, month: 9 }} onChange={setMonth} ariaLabel="Month" />
```

### TimeField

A time input with hour and minute columns in a popover.

```ts
import { TimeField } from '@/kit/components/calendar/TimePicker'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` *(required)* | `string` |  | "HH:MM" in 24-hour time, or empty. |
| `onChange` *(required)* | `(value: string) => void` |  | Called with the new time. |
| `step` | `5 \| 10 \| 15 \| 30` | `15` | Minutes between choices. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `'Select time'` | Shown when empty. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` |  | Accessible name when not inside a Field. |

```tsx
<Field label="Time"><TimeField value={time} onChange={setTime} /></Field>
```

### EventCalendar

A full-width month grid that lists events inside each day (dots on small screens).

```ts
import { EventCalendar } from '@/kit/components/calendar/EventCalendar'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `month` *(required)* | `Date` |  | Any date in the month to show. |
| `events` *(required)* | `{ id: string; date: Date; title: string; tone: "accent" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "error" }[]` |  | Events to place. |
| `selected` *(required)* | `Date \| null` |  | Highlighted day. |
| `onSelect` *(required)* | `(date: Date) => void` |  | Called when a day is chosen. |

```tsx
<EventCalendar month={month} events={events} selected={day} onSelect={setDay} />
```
